title: Entries in flattened blocks
statement: Let $L$ be a finite list of finite lists of elements of a type, and let $w$ be a natural number such that every list in $L$ has length $w$. For natural numbers $j,t$ with $j$ less than the number of lists in $L$ and $t<w$, and any element $d$, the entry of the concatenation of the lists at position $wj+t$ is equal to the entry of the $j$th list at position $t$.
